fact: La Nation's editorial says the Stratégie Nationale du Haut-Débit (SNHD), aligned with Vision Djibouti 2035, was recently unveiled, with two scenarios to connect ten or seven cities by 2027; it gives no plan period, and the date is the document's published date.
Djibouti launched its national broadband development strategy on 16 October 2024 at a Ministry of Communication workshop, presented by Minister Radwan Abdillahi Bahdon; no end date is given.

We are Tech says the strategy is part of the World Bank-supported Djibouti Digital Foundation project, with early results of 250 km of fibre in the north and over 100 administrative buildings connected.
